name: MGSM
description: Multilingual Grade School Math translates 250 problems from GSM8K into 11 languages (German, French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Thai, Swahili, Bengali, Telugu, and the original English) to evaluate math reasoning across diverse languages. Allows direct comparison of multilingual math reasoning performance and reveals cross-lingual transfer of arithmetic reasoning.
typical_sota_score: ~85–95% average across 11 languages (frontier models as of 2025–2026; underlying GSM8K is saturated)
reputation: Most frequently used multilingual math benchmark in major model reports; developed by Google Research; cited in multilingual and reasoning evaluation papers; included in Artificial Analysis Multilingual Index
notes: 250 problems × 11 languages = 2,750 total questions. Reveals significant performance gaps between high-resource languages (German, French) and low-resource ones (Bengali, Telugu, Swahili). Chain-of-Thought prompting in the target language outperforms English-only CoT for many languages. Now partially inherited GSM8K's saturation issues.
